shortBulletSummary: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged, but a hawkish tone on inflation hints at future rate hikes, generally bearish for crypto.
Bitcoin held above $64K and Ethereum near $1.9K, but trading volumes remain low amidst mixed altcoin performance.
Robinhood's Q2 crypto trading revenue dropped 38%, signaling reduced retail investor engagement in digital assets.
Escalating US-Iran tensions are reducing overall market risk appetite, pushing oil prices higher and pressuring crypto.
Upcoming earnings from MicroStrategy and Coinbase, along with PCE inflation data, are critical for short-term market direction.
